desc: The roots of the Browning BAR run deep, tracing its history back to John M. Browning's original design for the U.S. military during the First World War. These legendary firearms earned an amazing service record, being used even into the early days of the Vietnam War. The BAR MK 4 Medallion Americana offers a classic rifle enthusiast a patriotic experience, featuring a beautiful Grade III walnut stock with an oil finish. The nickel finish on the intricately engraved receiver enhances the stock and elevates the standard. Furthermore, the engraving of a waving American flag and "250 Years of Freedom" makes this Medallion rifle truly unique. A fluted polished blued barrel provides an excellent combination of the medallion design and exceptional accuracy. The gas-operated autoloader features a robust, rotating bolt that secures itself within the barrel. Furthermore, the rifle's durable action bar/inertia block connection minimizes barrel vibrations, enhancing overall accuracy.
